verdict.rationale: Letta supports scheduled/recurring automated prompts (letta-docs-69), event hooks via mods (letta-docs-71, letta-docs-94), and Slack always-on triggers where mentions cause agent action (letta-docs-73, letta-docs-83), which together constitute rule-based, event-triggered automation. However, there is no evidence of a general-purpose rules engine allowing arbitrary custom conditional triggers across diverse event types (e.g., webhooks, file changes, external system events) beyond schedules, Slack mentions, and mod-defined hooks. missing for 10: a documented general event-trigger/rules API covering arbitrary external events, examples of custom conditional logic definitions, and independent/hands-on confirmation of automation reliability.
